methodology.management: next session D+1 option OHLC; SL -30%; TP1 +40% half; remainder at D+1 close; SL checked before TP within the same bar (conservative)
methodology.evaluation_clock: 14:00 IST on session D (inside skill's 09:30-14:45 window)
methodology.expiry_gate: skill's <3h-to-expiry theta gate preserved (fires on expiry-day sessions at 14:00)
methodology.missing_data: skill rules preserved (unavailable groups score 0; option chain missing -> NO_TRADE)
methodology.no_optimization: thresholds fixed a priori: 40 (spec), 20, 15 - no parameter tuning

integrity.look_ahead: signals computed from session-D data only (bhavcopy D, spot D 14:00, VIX D, FII D); D+1 OHLC used only for post-entry trade management
integrity.synthetic_data: none - all prices/OI from NSE bhavcopy archives and Yahoo Finance; IV back-derived from real option closes via Black-Scholes inversion
